title: kith-chat: Chat/changes and Chat/query
description:
What: Implement Chat/changes and Chat/query JmapHandler structs in kith-chat crate.

Chat/changes algorithm:
1. Deserialize args: { accountId, sinceState: String, maxChanges: Option<u32> }.
2. Verify accountId == 'a-self'.
3. Acquire store lock.
4. Call store.chats().get_changes_since(sinceState)?; KithError::Validation → JmapError::state_mismatch().
5. Return { accountId, oldState: sinceState, newState, hasMoreChanges: false, created: added, updated, destroyed }.

Chat/query algorithm:
1. Deserialize args: { accountId, filter, sort, position, limit, calculateTotal }.
2. Verify accountId.
3. store.chats().list()? → Vec<Chat> ordered by lastMessageAt DESC NULLS LAST, createdAt DESC (store already returns this order).
4. Extract IDs only.
5. Apply position+limit.
6. queryState = store.chats().get_state()?
7. Return { accountId, queryState, canCalculateChanges: true, position, ids, total }.

Defensive programming rules:
- sinceState: validated by get_changes_since; propagate KithError::Validation as state_mismatch.
- position/limit: treat None as 0/max; clamp to u32; no overflow.
- v1: ignore filter and sort fields in Chat/query (accept but do not apply).
- Store lock released before return.

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read kith-store/src/chat.rs (get_changes_since as of KITH-vx6.2, list, get_state).
- Agent I: Implement ChatChangesHandler and ChatQueryHandler in kith-chat/src/chat.rs.
- Agent T: Tests with hand-constructed state sequences (oracle: RFC 8620 field names, known state token format 's-N').
- Agent V: cargo test -p kith-chat && clippy && fmt.

Tests:
- Chat/changes sinceState==currentState → empty
- Chat/changes sinceState < current after chat created → chat ID in added list
- Chat/changes malformed sinceState → error
- Chat/query → IDs in lastMessageAt desc order
- Chat/query position+limit pagination
